how_to_read: My review of the judge, after reading every answer it marked wrong or partly outside story 5. Story 2's mistake 2 ('must wait, cannot ask now') and story 5 (whether a text can be the notice) wait on the author, so those grades stand as the judge gave them.

deposit-4/2.why: 'You can get the other $400' and 'entitled to the entire $1,050' agree; the judge read a contradiction that is not there.

deposit-1/2.why: It says both deadlines passed, but ties the forfeiture to the 30-day notice; it does not say the 15-day return causes it.

deposit-2/2.why: It says the landlord forfeits only if no notice comes by August 30, and that the tenant can ask now, as the key does; the judge flagged a mistake it did not make.
